description: 十字斩: cross targets, SM_CROSSHIT action, 80% damage against player targets

stages.note: Client sends attacker position; cross targets are resolved server-side.

stages.action: HitHit checks CrossHit MP before resolving target; if MP is present, DamageSpell(GetSWSpell(PCrossHitSkill)+DefSpell) and HealthSpellChanged run, otherwise hitmode downgrades to RM_HIT.

rules: Monster/NPC targets use full cross-hit damage.

messages.condition: adjacent main target exists and the normal _Attack hit check passes
messages.note: Main-target struck is queued by the normal _Attack path.
DirectAttack queues visible struck after 500ms; non-human targets also receive immediate internal RM_STRUCK for AI reaction.

stages.rule: Train cross-hit sword skill on successful monster/animal hit path.

stages.note: HitMotion runs after _Attack returns; visible SM_STRUCK messages were already queued with their delays.

cplusplus_mapping.config_note: Magic ID 34 is source-only in MDB and must be deliberately provided when enabled.
